data.name: RemoveCrop_RemovedChat
data.comment: Scheduler.Tasks.Task_RemoveCrop.TryEnqueue, chatMessage counterpart of RemoveCrop_Removed. {0} is the removed crop's produce name, a client-language name; {1} is the bed number via Formats.Number.

data.name: Cleanup_NoQuitEntry
data.value: Stop: the open bed menu has no {0} entry; closing it directly instead.
data.comment: Helpers.GardeningUiCleanup.CloseBedMenu, ActivityLog.Warn_ Log-tab-only message (chat: false) when the bed's SelectString offers no MenuKey.EndEvent entry to close through properly. {0} is nameof(MenuKey.EndEvent), a diagnostic identifier that stays untranslated per the do-not-translate register (not routed through GameWords.Action, which has no mapping for this housekeeping key).

data.name: Cleanup_ClosedBedMenu
data.value: Stop: closed the open bed menu.
data.comment: Helpers.GardeningUiCleanup.CloseBedMenu, ActivityLog.Notify Log-tab-only message (chat: false) on the normal EndEvent close path. No slots.

data.name: Cleanup_ClosedAddon
data.comment: Helpers.GardeningUiCleanup.CloseAddonByName, ActivityLog.Notify Log-tab-only message (chat: false) when a plain AtkUnitBase.Close succeeds. {0} is the addon's own name (PlantDialogAddonName "HousingGardening" or ContextMenuAddonName "ContextMenu"), a client addon name that stays untranslated per the do-not-translate register.

data.name: Cleanup_AddonWouldNotClose
data.value: Stop: {0} was open but would not close.
data.comment: Helpers.GardeningUiCleanup.CloseAddonByName, ActivityLog.Warn_ Log-tab-only message (chat: false) when AtkUnitBase.Close returns false. {0} is the addon's own name, untranslated per the do-not-translate register.

data.name: ActivityLog_SkippedBeds_One
data.comment: Helpers.ActivityLog.FlushPendingSkip, singular branch (exactly one bed pending). {0} is that one bed's own number, an integer via Formats.Number (not a count - the n == 1 case names the specific bed rather than saying "1 bed"); {1} is the already-localized chatReason shared by every SkippedBed call in this run.

data.name: ActivityLog_SkippedBeds_Other
data.comment: Helpers.ActivityLog.FlushPendingSkip, plural branch (n != 1 pending beds sharing one chatReason, collapsed into a single chat line - see the class summary). {0} is the pending count, an integer via Formats.Number; {1} is the already-localized chatReason.
